company.name: Octant Bio
company.shortDescription: Octant Bio is a developer of synthetic technology used to improve health and treat disease.
company.description: Octant Bio is a developer of synthetic technology used to improve health and treat disease. Its technology uses synthetic biology, genome engineering, next-generation sequencing, and computational tools to simultaneously measure the activity of thousands of receptor pathways in human cells that enable scientists to apply machine learning methods to engineer small molecules that interact with multiple receptors and unlock a new potential to treat complex diseases.

productsAndServices.description: A technique that measures the functional effects of every possible amino acid variation within a protein to link protein structure to function for drug discovery.
productsAndServices.name: Deep Mutational Scanning (DMS)

productsAndServices.description: A platform to design, build, and test hundreds to thousands of genetic reporters in living cells simultaneously to measure cellular mechanisms for drug discovery.
productsAndServices.name: Multiplexed Cellular Assay and Reporter Development

productsAndServices.description: A system for synthesizing and screening large chemical libraries by combining molecular fragments and cores at nanoscale volumes using lab automation.
productsAndServices.name: Nano-scale High-Throughput Chemistry Platform

productsAndServices.description: An in-house sequencing system providing next-day full plasmid sequencing directly from bacterial colonies to verify genetic constructs.
productsAndServices.name: OCTOPUS Sequencing Platform

productsAndServices.description: A web-based application for designing and automating chemical transfer instructions to lab automation systems for high-throughput compound synthesis and quality control.
productsAndServices.name: Chiron Chemical Library Design Tool

aiResearchSummary.text: Octant Bio is engaged in developing synthetic technologies for health improvement and disease treatment, as reflected in systems and methods for utilizing a plasma membrane anchored protease, quality control for reporter screening assays, systems for measuring cell signaling protein activity, and transcriptional relay systems to reduce background signal in protein expression. These areas highlight their focus on synthetic biology, assay quality, and cellular signaling analysis.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $80,000,000, or 69.57% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
